note: Every number below was checked against the official pages listed in 'source' on the 'verified' date. Requirements change: re-check them before relying on this file, and update 'verified'. A copy in %LOCALAPPDATA%\SSGen\store-presets.json overrides this one.

presets.name: Phone
presets.notes: 9:16 at 1080 px. Promotion needs at least four screenshots of at least 1080 px. Up to 8 per device type.

presets.name: 7-inch tablet
presets.notes: Tablets: at least 4 screenshots, sides between 1,080 and 7,680 px, 9:16 portrait or 16:9 landscape.

presets.name: 10-inch tablet
presets.notes: Tablets: at least 4 screenshots, sides between 1,080 and 7,680 px, 9:16 portrait or 16:9 landscape.

presets.name: Feature graphic
presets.notes: JPEG or 24-bit PNG (no alpha), exactly 1024 x 500 px.

presets.name: App icon
presets.notes: 32-bit PNG (with alpha), exactly 512 x 512 px, at most 1024 KB.

stores.name: App Store
stores.warning: SSGen renders your Android screens into iPhone-style frames. Apple expects screenshots to show the app's actual iOS interface: replace them with real iOS captures before submitting if the iOS app looks different.

presets.name: iPhone 6.9" (Dynamic Island, large)
presets.notes: If not provided, scaled screenshots for iPhone with Face ID (large display) are used.

presets.name: iPhone 6.5" (Face ID, large)
presets.notes: Required if the app runs on iPhone and screenshots for iPhone with Dynamic Island (large display) aren't provided.

presets.name: iPhone 6.1" (Dynamic Island, medium)
presets.notes: Required: at least one screenshot for iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display).

presets.name: iPad 13"
presets.notes: Required if the app runs on iPad.
